content:
Ana Chen: quick intake for new Grove-13B-qat model — need checklist for prompt formatting & API integration. bringing up for internal bench + hosted. priority? :wave:
Kai Nguyen: P1 for search relevance. main asks: tool-calling compatibility, structured output, chat template changes, API surface ok?
Emma Li: add evals: n-shot instruction-following, hallucination checks, structured-output schema conformance. share sample prompts.
Raj Patel: quant note: try int4 and int8 profiles. check lora/PEFT compatibility. latency target 80ms p95 @512 tokens on dedicated.
model-bot: MODEL-3421 registered by @ana
Dave T: pasted quick checklist snippet below
Dave T: ```
- Owner: @Emma Li
- Priority: P1 (search relevance)
- Infra: Dedicated pool (DGX-1A), fallback: model-small-v2
- Quant profiles: int4-qat, int8-static
- Eval sets: onboard_core_v1, safety_negatives_v2, tools_smoke_v1
- Smoke checks: tokenization parity, top-p behavior, tool call stability
- API tests: streaming, function-calling, structured-output parsing
- Rollout: canary 5%, monitor perplexity + user-facing regressions
```
Emma Li: sample chat template for structured output:
Emma Li: ```json
{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Find nearest cafes and return JSON array with {name,lat,lon,open_now}"}],"response_schema":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"},"lat":{"type":"number"},"lon":{"type":"number"},"open_now":{"type":"boolean"}}}}
```
Emma Li: tool-calling example (must preserve `tool_call` field):
Emma Li: ```
{"tool_call":{"name":"places_search","args":{"q":"cafes near 94107","limit":5}},"stop":"\\n"}
```
Kai Nguyen: add: verify deterministic structured output across repeated seeds and check `null` vs empty list edgecases.
Raj Patel: also check tokenizer special tokens for tool markers. mismatch causes broken parsing.
Ana Chen: ok owner @Emma Li — can you run smoke eval with `onboard_core_v1` and post diffs + perf numbers here?
Emma Li: running now. will post SNR table + diffs to /shared/onboard/1940012345 by EOD.
Dave T: small ops note: ensure model registry entry includes `compatible_with_function_calling: true` flag.
Emma Li: noted. will add the flag if passes smoke tests.
Kai Nguyen: fallback strategy: route to model-small when model can't meet latency or fails schema; log deviation rate.
Ana Chen: thanks all — next sync Wed 10am. tagging for heads-up: @product, @sre
